review_description: Very early but so far so good. The installations and pre installation were very seamless and done professionally.
Quoting process was the best. Michael was accurate and flexible and willing to quote on all options we were considering. Excellent customer service. Excellent communication.

We used a crowd which I thought was your referral that go by the name Impact Energy and I would recommend them highly. system has been working for only 48hrs and presently are waiting for retailer to install a new digital meter.
Good advice and able to design and install a system which met our needs.
